bugs.error_message: InvalidAccessKeyId: The key '005c37957e...' is not valid (HTTP 403) on B2 PutObject/ListBuckets
bugs.root_cause: B2_ENDPOINT/B2_REGION were us-west-004 but bucket tiger-builder lives in us-east-005 (s3ApiUrl from b2_authorize_account). Credentials were valid for native B2 API.
bugs.fix: Set B2_ENDPOINT=https://s3.us-east-005.backblazeb2.com and B2_REGION=us-east-005; also set requestChecksumCalculation/responseChecksumValidation to WHEN_REQUIRED for AWS SDK v3 + B2.

bugs.error_message: Greenhouse Alpaca job URL returned 422: companyName empty while title and description were present
bugs.root_cause: Zyte jobPosting extraction omitted hiringOrganization.name even at probability 0.999.
bugs.fix: Fetch Zyte browserHtml and extract companyName, jobTitle, and jobDescription with DeepSeek deepseek-flash JSON mode.

bugs.error_message: Hyland iCIMS job URL returned 422: title and company present, jobDescription length 0
bugs.root_cause: iCIMS embeds the posting in an iframe. Zyte browserHtml leaves iframe bodies empty unless includeIframes is true, so DeepSeek had no description to extract.
bugs.fix: Set includeIframes: true on the Zyte browserHtml request. Retest returned Hyland / Platform Infrastructure Engineer with a 6626-character description.
